residuals.title: Forgiving-seam contract still incomplete: ingest_event() can still RAISE
residuals.proof: advisor probe: event_ts = year-max datetime with NEGATIVE tz offset -> OverflowError escapes ingest_event (audit lost); a tzinfo whose utcoffset() raises -> RuntimeError escapes. normalize_ts's catch tuple is (ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError) only; the validate/resolve/subject_matches/store.append callee-raise paths are also unwrapped.
residuals.impact_at_m6.2b: A hostile/edge event_ts in the HTTP body causes a 500 with NO audit record, breaking the seam's own 'rejected/held is audited, never silently lost' contract (violates SMK-001 audit-clarity).
residuals.required_fix: Widen the seam's ts-normalization guard to catch OverflowError and any tzinfo-raised exception (broaden to `except Exception` around normalize_ts, or catch OverflowError + wrap the astimezone), and wrap the remaining external-callee calls (validate/resolve/subject_matches/store.append) so each becomes an AUDITED DENY, never a raise.

residuals.title: Consent gate fail-open reachable via a ConsentSnapshot SUBCLASS that skips __post_init__
residuals.proof: advisor probe: a ConsentSnapshot subclass overriding __post_init__ to a no-op keeps consent_scope as a raw str; isinstance(evil, ConsentSnapshot) is True so it passes the seam FIX-2 isinstance guard and reaches gate.evaluate, where `scope not in <raw str>` does SUBSTRING matching -> evaluate() returns True (fail-open) for a scope string the snapshot does not actually grant. Through the seam today egress stays False (permits_external_send()==False) so it does not trip FAIL-002 yet, but the reader-attested id IS written to the append-only log with a wrong consent decision.
residuals.impact_at_m6.2b: Once a real ConsentReader adapter can return a subclass (or OD-003 unlocks egress), a consent DENY is read as a GRANT at the money/PII decision point (FAIL-002).
residuals.required_fix: Harden the DECISION POINT itself, not just the seam: in gate.evaluate assert/validate that snapshot.consent_scope is a frozenset[ConsentScope] (coerce-or-deny), so the gate is correct regardless of what type the seam hands it. This is the gate-level half of the original MAJOR-7 fix recommendation that was not implemented in Round 4.
